synthesis.headline: Management dropped key operational guidance while annual revenue and profit continued expanding steadily.

points.text: Management dropped net interest margin and loan growth mentorship after January 2026, leaving those near-term targets unverified.
FY27 NIM guidance and cost-to-topline growth objectives remain unverifiable due to lack of specific metrics or table data.
Annual revenue grew consistently to reach 195218.0 crore by March 2026.
Annual profit after tax showed continuous growth, reaching 57936.0 crore in March 2026.

bull.text: Annual revenue grew from 159516.0 crore in March 2024 to 195218.0 crore by March 2026.
Annual PAT improved steadily over the years, reaching 57936.0 crore for March 2026.

bear.text: Operating margins remained negative, standing at -18.8% for the year ending March 2026.
Cash from operations dropped significantly to 67325.0 crore for March 2026.
